mapper.select: SELECT id,phone,nickname,avatar_url,gender,birthday,region,signature,create_time FROM app_user WHERE id=#{id} AND del_flag='0'
SELECT id,device_id,platform,device_model,system_version,app_version,last_active_time,status FROM user_device WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY last_active_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE user_device SET status='1' WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND device_id=#{deviceId}
